interest: Japanese warships plan a visit to Barranquilla, 1937.
overview: Dawson's despatch No. 1320 (1937): two Japanese warships to visit Barranquilla, after British, German and other visits.

subfiles.about: U.S. Minister William Dawson reports planned visits of two Japanese naval warships and other foreign naval vessels to the newly inaugurated port of Barranquilla.
subfiles.summary: Dawson reports two Japanese warships will visit Barranquilla and asks the consulate to report foreign naval calls.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1320 from William Dawson on Visits of Foreign War Vessels to Barranquilla

subfiles.about: Duplicate confirmation copy of Despatch No. 1320 concerning Japanese and foreign naval visits to the port of Barranquilla.
subfiles.summary: Confirmation copy of despatch No. 1320 on Japanese warships visiting Barranquilla.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 1320 (Confirmation Copy) from William Dawson on Visits of Foreign War Vessels to Barranquilla
